notes: regions.synapses = sum of syn_count in proofread_connections_783 per neuropil (connections are thresholded at >=5 synapses per neuron pair in that release)
region_edges [A,B,w]: w = synapses located in neuropil B made by neurons whose primary input neuropil is A (derived, A!=B); top 600
centroids = volume centroid of JFRC2 neuropil surface meshes in FlyWire space shipped with fafbseg-py; UNASGD and some regions have no mesh
neurons.p = soma position if soma=true, else annotation point position; voxel (4,4,40) nm converted to nm
neurons.np = neuropil with the most synapses (in+out); neurons.top = up to 5 strongest output partners within this sample [index, synapses]
